question: top 5 customers by order frequency
sql:
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM
    customers c
JOIN
    orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY
    c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY
    order_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
